# Alexandr Mangir — Senior Software Engineer

> Full-stack Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building high-performance, scalable web products: React, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, Node.js and NestJS on the backend, and AI features built on LLMs and RAG.

## Key facts

- Role: Senior Software Engineer, full stack
- Experience: 8+ years; 3 platforms built on micro-frontend architecture, 2 company-wide design systems
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query, Tailwind, React Native
- Architecture: micro-frontends (Module Federation, Single-SPA), design systems, FSD, DDD
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Stripe
- AI: LLMs, RAG, embeddings and vector search, AI agents, MCP
- 3D and real-time: Three.js, socket.io, rich editors, DXF
- Education: MSc in Applied Mathematics & Computer Science, Shevchenko Transnistria State University

## Selected work

- maib design system: shared UI component library for product teams, micro-frontends for digital banking, card management for corporate clients
- Otherweb & PressHub: a junk-free news platform that uses AI to filter clickbait and misinformation, plus an AI editorial workflow for journalists
- [Raters](https://www.ratersapp.com/): a social network for movie lovers with a Telegram Mini App, Web3 login and an x402 paid API for AI agents
- Flowqe: a web CAD for electrical engineering with a diagram editor, real-time calculations and DXF import/export
- [Everact](https://everact.io/): a platform to create and sell online courses with an LMS, a visual funnel builder and Stripe billing
- RAG & AI workflows: RAG over internal knowledge, workflow automation and spec-driven development with coding agents

## How he works

Discover → Architect → Build → Launch & grow: clear scope first, architecture that scales, short iterations with demos, then monitoring and improvements based on real usage.
